name: teach-player
description: Watch and interact with an AI coding-agent teaching session in the browser: live terminal next to the lesson content it writes.

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.js && esbuild src/client/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --outdir=dist && cp src/client/index.html dist/
